items.uz: Bu safar qanday xayriya tadbiri o'tkazsak bo'ladi?
items.en: What kind of charity event should we hold this time?
In my opinion, collecting clothes is a good idea.
In your opinion, when would it be convenient to hold it?
We'll announce it through social media.

items.uz: Natijada, ko'plab odamlar qatnashadi, deb umid qilaman.
items.en: As a result, I hope many people will participate.
Where will the funds be spent?
To families in need and to orphanages.

items.uz: Bu ajoyib g'oya, albatta yordam beraman.
items.en: This is a wonderful idea, I'll definitely help.

items.uz: Rahmat, hamjihatlik bilan katta ish qilamiz.
items.en: Thank you, together we'll do great work.
A small kindness makes a big difference.
